profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft | MSCS Candidate @ GT
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer at Microsoft working on production systems that power customer-facing experiences for Copilot. I enjoy building reliable software, improving system observability, and developing infrastructure that helps teams ship high-quality features at scale.

In my current role, I’ve worked on production features, live-site reliability, internal engineering tooling, and release pipelines that support enterprise Copilot deployments. I’m particularly interested in the intersection of AI-powered products, scalable systems, and developer infrastructure.

Alongside my industry work, I’m pursuing a Master of Science in Computer Science with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence at Georgia Institute of Technology, where I’m deepening my understanding of intelligent systems and applied AI.

Before Microsoft, I studied Software Engineering at Morehouse College, where I also served as a teaching assistant and tutor in the computer science department. Teaching and mentorship remain important to me, and I enjoy helping others grow while continuing to learn from those around me.

I’m especially interested in building systems that combine AI capabilities with robust engineering foundations, enabling intelligent products to operate reliably at scale.
